implemented_requirements.requirement: Read input text file (with configurable encoding)
implemented_requirements.evidence: FileHandler.read_text_file is called in main.run() with args.encoding

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromic words in the text
implemented_requirements.evidence: PalindromeDetector.find_word_palindromes scans each token and uses is_palindrome

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromic sentences/phrases in the text
implemented_requirements.evidence: PalindromeDetector.find_sentence_palindromes splits lines via split_sentences and tests each chunk
Command‑line flag --case-sensitive toggles ignore_case when constructing PalindromeDetector

implemented_requirements.requirement: Allow inclusion or stripping of punctuation
implemented_requirements.evidence: Command‑line flag --keep-punctuation toggles ignore_punctuation when constructing PalindromeDetector

implemented_requirements.requirement: Support a minimum palindrome length filter
implemented_requirements.evidence: Argument --min-length is passed to PalindromeDetector.min_length and enforced in is_palindrome

implemented_requirements.requirement: Generate a human‑readable report of findings
implemented_requirements.evidence: ResultReporter.build_report formats word and sentence palindrome counts and details

implemented_requirements.requirement: Optionally save the report to an output file
implemented_requirements.evidence: ResultReporter.save_report writes the built report via FileHandler.write_text_file when --output is supplied

judge.summary: The provided codebase implements a complete, configurable palindrome detection tool that reads a text file, finds palindromic words and sentences, and reports the results. All core functionalities are present and the code appears syntactically correct and ready to execute, meeting the benchmark requirement.
